title: RKM Embedded Tool Definition
description: Defines a reusable embedded tool fragment for a bounded callable capability used by agents, workflows, frameworks, components or humans in a RAG system. This schema does not provide the full knowledge entity envelope for Tool: it intentionally omits first-class identity, metadata, description and top-level relationships. A complete first-class Tool entity schema must be introduced separately after shared identity, registry and relationship support exists for Tool.

toolId.description: Stable local identifier for this embedded tool fragment within the containing entity, workflow, contract, execution trace or evidence record.

invocationModes.description: Supported ways the callable capability can be invoked.

inputs.description: Structured artifacts consumed by the tool.

outputs.description: Structured artifacts produced or emitted by the tool.

capabilities.description: Embedded capabilities exposed by the tool.

policies.description: Embedded policy fragments that govern tool invocation, inputs, outputs or side effects.

securityControls.description: Security controls relevant to invoking or operating the tool.

sideEffects.description: State changes or external effects caused by invoking the tool.

dependencies.description: External systems, providers, services or first-class RKM entities the tool depends on.

relationships.description: First-class relationships that connect this embedded tool fragment to existing RKM entities when those links have reusable semantic value.

claims.description: Claims that assert, qualify or compare tool behavior, capability, safety, quality, cost or limitations.

evidence.description: Evidence records supporting the tool boundary, contract, behavior or related claims.

references.description: Structured sources cited for the tool.

usageGuidance.description: Guidance for correctly invoking, composing or governing the tool in RAG systems.

toolType.description: Primary callable capability exposed by the tool.

invocationMode.description: How the callable capability is invoked.

boundary.description: Scope boundary for the callable capability.

allowedInvokers.description: Actors or systems expected to invoke the tool.

excludedResponsibilities.description: Responsibilities explicitly outside the tool boundary.

authorizationRequirements.description: Authorization requirements that must be satisfied before invocation.

invokerType.description: Type of actor or system that may invoke the tool.

stateChangePolicy.description: Whether tool invocation is expected to change external or persistent state.

sideEffect.description: State change or external effect caused by invocation.

target.description: System, artifact, index, database, user or workflow affected by the side effect.

reversible.description: Whether the side effect can be reversed through normal operation.

evidenceRelevant.description: Whether the side effect should be captured as evidence or audit data.

sideEffectType.description: Kind of state change or external effect.

dependency.description: External system, provider, service or first-class RKM entity required by the tool.

availabilityImpact.description: How dependency unavailability affects tool invocation.

operationalCharacteristics.description: Operational properties relevant to invoking and governing the tool.

observabilitySignals.description: Signals that should be captured for monitoring, evaluation or audit.

failureModes.description: Expected operational failures callers or workflows should handle.
